model: Existing bounded Q1, W0 fixed mass, Re=infinity; same native RK4/force/mesh and existing EUNHA_KEPLER_DTETA only
restart_policy: Use earliest main-chain positive checkpoint .825 only if its original 28 checks and all added core screens pass; otherwise reuse the exact saved original IC, without IC regeneration. Never choose a later checkpoint to hide an early failure.
future_branch_policy: Keep current t10/short-step bundle. A single capped native branch follows their evaluation. Existing coarse endpoints are the controls; do not rerun coarse. No integrator/mesh/weights/spin changes in that branch.
invariants: Report regional energy/angular-momentum increments and trends; do not assume each region separately conserves them. Retain all original 28 global/disk gates.
scope: Preregistered numerical accuracy screens for restart eligibility and capped-branch diagnosis. These tolerances are experimental criteria, not thresholds attributed to the GIZMO paper. Circular tessellation is a kinematic reference, not an exact finite-cell fluid solution. Passing cannot establish boundary equivalence or final long-time stability.
